notes.title: Galactic Explorers
notes.content:
Galactic Explorers brings all the good stuff over from the recent PS4/PS5 release of ADIOS Amigos:
[list]
[*] Brand new intro campaign (fully playable in coop)
[*] Ground Roving Shuttle
[*] Free zooming camera
[*] Bird lifeforms
[*] Parties
[*] Additional music
[*] Ship and astronaut datasheets on selection screens
[*] 42% more interesting discovery tracking
[*] And more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33500729/27a40b06e0e781ea60f6df1cb0aa8ea377be4455.gif[/img]

notes.title: ADIOS Amigos v1.1 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33500729/b4b0c71e775aebf4ff3ade6e63a8bf5d4a0c6ee4.gif[/img]
ADIOS Amigos the rogue-lite space-sim-platformer has just received its first major update!
We have listened to your feedback...
[list]
[*]In-game menu with help and quit options
[*]Improved support for non 16:9 monitors
[*]Improved support for Xbox 360 controllers
[*]Lots of bug fixes!
[/list]
[i]
"ADIOS Amigos is possibly my favorite indie game this year."
 - The indie Toaster

"It takes a LOT to surprise me these days, but this charming combination of exploration, puzzle solving and resource management managed to do just that. It has an amazing control scheme too. Buy it!"
 - Space Game Junkie

"Adorable, fun, witty space and physics sim/platformer, easy to pick up, hard to put down"
 - Mr Flatulent

"Spelunky HD and No Man's Sky had a CHILD!"
 - Mindslam

"Awesome and fun Astro game for EVERYONE. really enjoying this. As a musician i also really dig the music. well worth the time and money."
 - Kubel83
[/i]

notes.title: ADIOS Amigos 1.1 Update
notes.content:
The response from our players have been overwhelming, thank you!
We read everything and are very grateful for your help in improving ADIOS Amigos.
Here is the first round of updates and improvements!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33500729/0bbc6bd10f48af83fd4a2e49a5737c92dfc0b6e0.png[/img]
[h1]Release notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]In-game menu with help and quit options
[*]Improved support for non 16:9 monitors
[*]Some users have experienced controller issues caused by worn (loose) thumb-sticks. this should no longer be a problem.
[*]Improved stability
[*]Added support for error reporting
[*]Fixed leaderboard browsing
[*]Disabled the possibility of becoming passenger while playing single player.
[*]Tweaked the "Sweet-tooth", "Take me to your Leader" and "Amazing Discoverer" achievements
[*]Button-prompts for "Revive" now working properly
[*]Fixed broken pop-up icons for powerups in co-op
[*]Improved memory management
[*]Fixed faulty button prompts for controllable rocket-engines on space-stations
[*]Fixed crew-display sometimes showing incorrect images for docked space-shuttles
[*]Fixed issue where you couldn't join with additional players after playing a round
[*]Fixed graphical glitches for jetpack effects and carried astronauts
[/list]
